title: The Camp David accords are a framework signed by Sadat and Begin
summary: The 1978 Camp David framework is an Egypt-Israel text negotiated with Carter.
body: Avalon prints the Framework for Peace in the Middle East, signed after Sadat and Begin met Carter at Camp David. The framework is a negotiated text between Egypt and Israel, with the United States as host. It is not a treaty with the Palestine Liberation Organization. The wording on the page includes: "at Camp David from September 5 to September 17, 1978, and have agreed on the following framework for peace in the Middle East. They invite other parties to the Arab-Israel conflict to adhere to it. Preamble The search for peace in the Middle East must be guided by the following: The agreed basis for a peaceful settlement of the conflict between Israel and its neighbors is United".
said_by: Anwar al-Sadat and Menachem Begin, Avalon Project
